notes: Side HUD: the right-side boxes now show on short phone screens when the Minimap radar is hidden.
Rain Charm and Tide Boots now work on beaches and on sandstone paths in the rain.
Story Blood Moons and Harvest Moons never come two nights in a row, and never replace a moon an operator chose.
Mining the same stone spot again within 5 minutes gives no Mining XP, so cobblestone and basalt generators do not farm it.
The sky-wonder bonus in Frogs in Three Voices also works with Rainbows, Tornadoes or Storm Cells.
Town Projects residents can no longer breed.
resourceNotes: Side HUD: the right-side boxes start right under the compass when the Minimap radar is hidden, so they show on short phone screens.

hud_rp.notes: The right-side boxes start right under the compass when the Minimap radar is hidden, so they show on short phone screens.

relics_bp.notes: Rain Charm and Tide Boots count natural sand, red sand, terracotta, snow and ice as dry ground only; sandstone, glazed terracotta, stairs and slabs do not, and sand next to water (a beach) counts as rained on.

moon_bp.notes: A story request never overrides a moon an operator chose tonight (even an ordinary one) and never follows a moon night; moon:night now saves op and p.

skills_bp.notes: Breaking a stone-type block at the same spot again within 5 minutes gives no Mining XP, so cobblestone and basalt generators do not farm it.

town_bp.notes: Residents can no longer breed; leftovers from Remove spot are capped apart from the town limit; the realm:town_test hook needs the realm_test_hooks objective.

saga_bp.notes: The sky-wonder bonus in Frogs in Three Voices works with Rainbows, Tornadoes or Storm Cells too, and Mara mentions the sky when any of them is installed.

maps_bp.notes: Searches take turns so one long search cannot starve the others, a marker is built whole or not at all, and a record whose hunt owner never comes back is let go after 60 days.

platypus_bp.notes: A bite no longer throws an error when the event data is missing.

stash_bp.notes: The inventory page buttons are hidden from the creative inventory and the give command.

npc_bp.notes: Setting crownedGain to 0 now means no gain below Friend for the Hollow-Crowned.

wander_bp.notes: A wrongly accused friendly wanderer no longer adds to an unused counter; small comment fixes.

titles_bp.notes: The config comment lists every trail a built-in title can unlock.
